test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a month of 29 days, the second Thursday falls on the 13th day of the month. What day of the week will be the second last day of the month?
solution:
Given: 13th February of the month = Thursday. (As, 29 days month is February)

So, second last day of the month means 28th February,

And, days between 13th February to 28th February - 15 days.

And, 15 days = 15/7 = 2 week and **1 odd day**.

Then, the second last day of the month will be: Thursday + 1 = **Friday**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
